content.text: Once upon a time, there was a red apple.
The apple was very big and shiny.
content.translation: 这个苹果非常大，非常闪亮。

content.text: A little rabbit found the apple.
content.translation: 一只小兔子发现了这个苹果。

content.text: The rabbit was very happy!
I have a little cat.
The cat is white and soft.
content.translation: 小猫是白色的，毛茸茸的。

content.text: It likes to play with a ball.
I love my cat!

quiz.question: What does the cat like to play with?

content.text: Look at the sky. It is blue.
Look at the grass. It is green.
Look at the sun. It is yellow.
Colors are beautiful!
This is my family.
This is my mom. She is kind.
content.translation: 这是我的妈妈。她很善良。

content.text: This is my dad. He is strong.
content.translation: 这是我的爸爸。他很强壮。

content.text: I love my family!
Good morning! The sun is up.
I wake up and brush my teeth.
I eat breakfast. Yummy!
Time to go to school!
One apple. Two oranges.
Three bananas. Four grapes.
Five strawberries.
I love fruit!
I see a dog.
The dog is brown and big.
The dog can run fast.
The dog says woof woof!
I go to the park.
I see flowers. They are pretty.
I see trees. They are tall.
I love the park!
I have many toys.
I have a red car.
I have a teddy bear.
I play with my toys every day.
It is night time.
I see the moon. It is bright.
I see stars. They twinkle.
content.translation: 我看到星星。它们在闪烁。

content.text: Good night! Sweet dreams!
Let us play a game! What color do you see?
content.translation: 让我们玩个游戏！你看到什么颜色？

content.text: The apple is red. The sky is blue. The grass is green.
content.translation: 苹果是红色的。天空是蓝色的。草是绿色的。

content.text: I have many animal friends. Do you know them?
content.translation: 我有很多动物朋友。你认识它们吗？

content.text: The cat says meow. The dog says woof. The bird says chirp.
content.translation: 猫说喵。狗说汪。鸟说唧唧。

content.text: Can you count with me? One, two, three!
content.translation: 你能和我一起数数吗？一、二、三！

content.text: I have two eyes. I have one nose. I have ten fingers.
content.translation: 我有两只眼睛。我有一个鼻子。我有十个手指。

quiz.question: How many eyes do you have?
How many fingers do you have?

content.text: This is my family. We love each other.
content.translation: 这是我的家人。我们彼此相爱。

content.text: Dad is tall. Mom is kind. I am happy.
content.translation: 爸爸很高。妈妈很善良。我很开心。

content.text: Match the words! Big and small. Hot and cold.
content.translation: 配对单词！大和小。热和冷。

content.text: Happy and sad. Fast and slow. Up and down.
content.translation: 开心和悲伤。快和慢。上和下。

content.text: Read fast! The cat runs. The dog jumps. The bird flies.
content.translation: 快速阅读！猫在跑。狗在跳。鸟在飞。

content.text: The fish swims. The frog hops. The snake slides.
content.translation: 鱼在游泳。青蛙在跳。蛇在滑行。

content.text: Remember this! I see a red ball, a blue car, and a green tree.
content.translation: 记住这些！我看到一个红球，一辆蓝车，和一棵绿树。

content.text: I also see a yellow sun and a white cloud.
content.translation: 我还看到一个黄色的太阳和一朵白云。

content.text: Can you spell these words? C-A-T spells cat. D-O-G spells dog.
content.translation: 你能拼写这些单词吗？C-A-T拼成cat。D-O-G拼成dog。

content.text: B-A-L-L spells ball. S-U-N spells sun.
Listen carefully! I like to eat apples. I like to drink milk.
content.translation: 仔细听！我喜欢吃苹果。我喜欢喝牛奶。

content.text: I have a sister. Her name is Lily. She is five years old.
content.translation: 我有一个妹妹。她的名字叫莉莉。她五岁了。

quiz.question: What do I like to eat?

content.text: Deep in the forest lives a magical owl. He is the Forest Guardian.
content.translation: 在森林深处住着一只神奇的猫头鹰。他是森林守护者。

content.text: The owl is big and wise. His eyes are yellow. His feathers are brown.
content.translation: 猫头鹰又大又聪明。他的眼睛是黄色的。他的羽毛是棕色的。

content.text: He asks you: "Can you tell me about the forest? What animals live here?"
content.translation: 他问你："你能告诉我关于森林的事吗？什么动物住在这里？"

content.text: "You are very clever," says the owl. "You have learned so much!"
content.translation: "你非常聪明，"猫头鹰说。"你学到了很多！"

content.text: "Go to Echo Valley. New friends and adventures wait for you there!"
content.translation: "去回声山谷吧。新的朋友和冒险在那里等着你！"

quiz.question: What color are the owl's eyes?
What color are the owl's feathers?
